gloss: to stand out; to be set off; to look more attractive (by contrast or context)

definitions.gloss: to stand out; to be set off; to look more attractive (by contrast or context)
definitions.explanation: to stand out; to be set off; to look more attractive (by contrast or context)

examples.english: The colors of the food stand out on a white plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てている→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧。
examples.english: The red dress sets off her beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧な⟦{額縁|がくぶち}→額縁：16183_gakubuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the simple frame, the appeal of the painting itself stands out.

examples.english: Adding a little wasabi brings out the flavor of the sashimi.

notes:
Describes something looking more attractive, prominent, or noticeable thanks to its context, contrast, or an accompanying element. Used for visual appearance, flavors, talents, and other qualities. The transitive counterpart is ⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧ (to set off; to make something stand out).

TRANSITIVITY:
- {引|ひ}き{立|た}つ (intransitive): to stand out
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧ (transitive): to make something stand out; to set off; to promote

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ: colors stand out
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ: flavor is brought out
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}つ: charm stands out
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧: to bring out the best in each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: to stand out; to be conspicuous — can be positive or negative, while {引|ひ}き{立|た}つ always implies looking better or more attractive
- ⟦{映|は}える→映える：02393_haeru⟧: to look good; to be photogenic — focuses on visual appeal, especially in photography or against a background
